title: [Highlight] StarCraft Remastered Rant
summary: Day9 gives a passionate first look at what his StarCraft: Brood War Remastered series will teach. He argues Brood War is primarily a real-time game and only secondarily a strategy game, making the commander fantasy a matter of mechanics.
why: HN uses it to argue that mechanical difficulty and limited attention are integral to RTS strategy, especially in StarCraft AI threads.

quote.text: day[9] (ex Broodwar pro, current caster of many games) probably makes the argument better than I can here
